messages:
Lina: Heads-up: scheduling a late-night change window Fri 2026-03-27 23:45-01:15 UTC. Changes:
- runtime: KV retention lowered (40s->30s) for idle segments
- console: schema v4 behind gate
- router: header-split flag flip with temporary shim
Need cross-service pins, explicit manual gate at 60% and rollback plan.

deploy-bot: Deploy plan created by Lina. Canary plan: 5% (10m) -> 20% (10m) -> 60% hold (manual) -> 100% (rolling). Auto-rollback triggers: 5xx rate >2.5x baseline for 6m OR tail latency (P99) increase >300ms for 10m. Runbook: /playbooks/late-window-shim-schema

Omar: Runtime owner here. I'll pin runtime artifact to `runtime@2.2.0-evict30`. Also enabling detailed alloc/kv metrics. Command: `deploybot pin --service=runtime --artifact=runtime@2.2.0-evict30 --until=2026-03-28T04:00:00Z`

Priya: Console owner. We'll gate schema v4 under `console:feature.schema_v4`. I'll not flip until hold and will provide DB write migration and rollback hook. Pin: `deploybot pin --service=console --flag=console:feature.schema_v4 --until=2026-03-28T04:00:00Z`

Ethan: Router owner. I'll deploy `router#5.12.1-shim` and keep a translation shim for legacy header `X-RD-User` -> `X-RD-UserV2`. Shim emits `shim.active=1` logs. Pin: `deploybot pin --service=router --version=5.12.1-shim --until=2026-03-28T04:00:00Z`

Riley: On-call. My rollback checklist: 1) triage - confirm cross-service errors 2) if 3+ pods in two regions show 500/503s -> rollback 3) if console admin paths break -> rollback immediately. Need Sophia (db lead) to confirm DB revert job for enum rename is ready.

Priya: DB lead (Sophia) is OOO but I prepped a rollback job: `jobs/schema-revert-enum --id=console-v4-revert --dryrun=false`. This reverts addition and toggles flag off. It's idempotent. I'll attach it to the runbook.

Lina: Please paste pins here once executed so we have an audit trail. Also add short note in release notes about shim rationale.

Omar: Pin posted: `deploybot pin --service=runtime --artifact=runtime@2.2.0-evict30 --until=2026-03-28T04:00:00Z` ✅

Ethan: Pin posted: `deploybot pin --service=router --version=5.12.1-shim --until=2026-03-28T04:00:00Z` ✅ Shim logs tagged `shim.active`.

Priya: Pin posted: `deploybot pin --service=console --flag=console:feature.schema_v4 --until=2026-03-28T04:00:00Z` ✅ Runbook updated with `jobs/schema-revert-enum` command.

deploy-bot: All pins recorded. Canary start: 2026-03-27T23:45:00Z UTC. Alerts: perf/errors/traces -> #eng-oncall and #eng-releases. Manual hold scheduled at 60%.

Lina: Quick pre-flight checklist: 1) pins (yes) 2) runbook link (yes) 3) synthetic tests covering header translation and admin flows (Riley) 4) manual hold at 60% (yes) 5) rollback commands accessible (yes). If no objections kicking at 23:45 UTC.

Riley: Synthetics running green. Will monitor header translation metric `shim.translate.success_rate` and console admin error rate. Posting dashboards link: https://go/dash/late-window-shim

Omar: I'll stream KV eviction heatmap every 5m during canary. If we see eviction churn > expected threshold I'll flag immediately.

Ethan: Router shim logs will include `shim.translate=1` and error tag `shim.err`. I'll post any `shim.err` occurrences here.

Lina: Thanks team. Proceeding on schedule. Manual go/no-go at 60% will be requested from each owner in-thread. :rocket:
